report_name: ODVA's CIP Security Spec for EtherNet/IP Earns IEC 62443 Certification

identities.name: ODVA
identities.description: The industrial automation standards organization whose CIP Security specification for EtherNet/IP networks was certified against the IEC 62443-4-2 standard.

identities.name: TÜV Rheinland
identities.description: The organization that formally certified ODVA's CIP Security specification as compliant with the IEC 62443-4-2 international standard.

identities.name: European Union
identities.description: Mentioned in the context of its Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), which the new certification helps manufacturers comply with.
